title: TAP DANCE BASICS - 5 Steps EVERY Beginner should Master

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces core tap dance steps one by one, breaking down their mechanics and terminology. He demonstrates each movement with verbal counts and physical cues, then combines them into sequential practice routines. Finally, he speeds up the tempo and dances along to music so learners can apply what they learned.

practices.what: Teaches the ball and heel step by lifting and dropping the ball of the foot while keeping the heel lifted.
Teaches the brush step by shaking out ankle tension and brushing the foot forward and back.
Teaches the shuffle step by combining a forward brush and a backward brush.
Teaches the ball change step by stepping back and doing a quick weight change.
Teaches the flap step by brushing forward and stepping on the whole foot.
Teaches stomps and stamps, explaining the difference in weight distribution between them.
Puts all the learned steps together into a warm-up drill with music.

moments.says: The teacher introduces tap dance basics as the bread and butter of the form, getting started right now.
Teacher advises shaking out ankles to release tension before learning brushes.
Teacher names a common student confusion between shuffle and flap steps and demonstrates the correct execution.
Teacher asks viewers to like, share, subscribe, and leave comments for future videos.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling equipped and encouraged to master fundamental tap dance steps at their own pace.

method.limits: Only the instructor's lower body and feet are visible during most of the instructional segments, limiting observation of upper body posture.
